dedupe_keys.name: motorway traffic flow on the a1 and a13 with shoulder lanes open and closed 2007

description:
This record retains the saved broad name for 2007 motorway observations and its DOI anchor to a specific A13 shoulder-closed 1.1 stabilized deposit. The verified component inventory covers shoulder-open and shoulder-closed A13 observations on 14 November 2007. S.P.(Serge) Hoogendoorn deposited these resources in 4TU.ResearchData for TU Delft, Civil Engineering and Geosciences, Transport and Planning, to support traffic observation and congestion research.

The reviewed A13 inventory contains eleven traffic deposits and one shared lens-calibration image. It distinguishes session logs and road-location KML, raw PNG image archives with settings text, and stabilized archives with results or alignment-trace text where listed. Source locations include A13 kilometres 13.3, 14.5 and 15.6, between exits 10 and 11 in the Netherlands. ZIP archives are described as containing approximately 2,000 images each. Pixel resolution, frame interval and text field meanings are not stated. Publication was on 14 October 2010.

Public landing pages and native metadata APIs list access under 4TU General Terms of Use. Cost is not established. The observations and calibration context support road traffic-flow simulation. Distinct raw and stabilized identities are connected through explicit provider derivation fields; byte equivalence is unproved. Related record: data-4tu-repository. The earlier fifteen-deposit grouping cannot be reconstructed from retained evidence. The explicit A1 supplement adds thirteen native deposits covering shoulder-open observations on 1 November 2007 and shoulder-closed observations on 15 November 2007 between exits 21 and 23 of the Amsterdam–Oldenzaal motorway. The component identities distinguish raw and stabilized observation variants and session/location descriptors. Together with the retained eleven A13 traffic deposits and one shared calibration image, the reviewed group has 25 explicitly identified native components. This is a count of deposits and representations, not 25 separate traffic experiments. Frame intervals, image resolution and file values were not inspected. Files and executable analysis workflows were not inspected.

name: Motorway traffic flow on the A1 and A13 with shoulder lanes open and closed, 2007
notes:
Harvested from 4TU.ResearchData on 2026-09-29 in the round 2 research-repositories pass, selected by keyword match and title review; publisher recorded in the metadata: 4TU.Centre for Research Data. Series of 15 deposits; other members include: Traffic flow A13 Rotterdam Delft, shoulder open, 2007-11-14, 3.2, stabilized data; Traffic flow A13 Rotterdam Delft, shoulder closed, 2007-11-14; Traffic flow A13 Rotterdam Delft, shoulder closed, 2007-11-14, 3.1, raw data; Traffic flow A13 Rotterdam Delft, shoulder open, 2007-11-14; ....

Source verification update, 8 October 2026: The earlier 15-deposit statement is historical and its complete identities are unavailable. It is not a verified current collection size. Native parent collection 5ab3da96 contains 24 current members; six reviewed 2007 traffic deposits are absent from that collection. This prepared supplement binds eleven A13 traffic deposits plus one shared calibration image to two already represented source-named events. This expansion supersedes their earlier grouping holds. The historical fifteen-member inventory remains unknown; these new explicit identities are not asserted to be its original fifteen. The reviewed group now contains 24 traffic deposits and one shared calibration image, with no new resource or independent experiment count.
